verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live public OpenAPI spec at daytona.io/openapi.json. The docs describe programmatic sandbox management through official Python and TypeScript SDKs (with code examples), and the agent skill references patterns for the Daytona API plus Go and Ruby SDKs. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) further support AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the REST API, and quoted API reference detail such as auth and endpoint coverage.
